column1: Atlas of multicolour lower bounds: summary by number of colours
Breakdown of the 6,426 rows of the Atlas tab, by number of colours, according to the origin of the best result.

Reading. “Published” and “Published (deduced)”: the best result comes from the literature (published value, or deduced from published values by a theorem). “Published bricks + theorems”: built by our planner with published bricks and theorems, without any of our bricks. “Our bricks + published”: built with one of our bricks, which adds a margin. “Our bricks”: built with our bricks, without which we would remain below the best published value or the value deduced from published ones. “Tabu”: non-linear colouring found by tabu search.
These rows are not records: for most parameters, no value is published. The eight records of the note are in the Our records tab; the detail of what comes from our bricks is in the Provenance tab.
